facts.text: Herzing University's Minneapolis campus operates a low-cost community dental clinic where dental hygiene and dental assisting students provide basic dental services to patients.

sources.title: Minneapolis Campus - Herzing University
sources.quote: We believe in giving back to our community through our low-cost Dental Clinic, where dental hygiene and dental assisting students can provide basic dental services to patients in the community.

facts.text: Founded by Henry and Suzanne Herzing in 1965, Herzing University was the first post-secondary institution focused on preparing students for careers in the computer industry.

sources.title: Facts about Herzing University
sources.quote: Founded by Henry and Suzanne Herzing in 1965, our family legacy continues with daughter, Renée Herzing, as president. First post-secondary institution focused on preparing students for careers in the computer industry.
